correctness_confidence.basis: All Hopfield A^2 normal-mode relations, 4x4 resonant symplectic covariances, virtual occupation (64/6177), squeezing (6177/6305), det(2Va), interaction-diamagnetic cancellation, PZW weight swap (7569/12610 vs 5041/12610), single-branch dipole norm (6177/12610), and 310 K KMS ratios check out exactly from the PDF prose. However, the N-dipole Hamiltonian and Driven Regime I entry in Table 3 are not derived explicitly, and external Lean/Python artifacts were not inspected.

rigor.basis: The single-mode Hopfield A^2 diagonalization, PZW unitary conjugation, passivity of |G>, and dressed KMS rate comparison are carried out cleanly in exact rational arithmetic. Section 3 transparently bounds what Layer 1 certifies versus Section 2 prose. Rigor is tempered because several Lean theorems (e.g., Thms. 9, 12, 15) formalize arithmetic tautologies after hand-cleared substitutions rather than operator-algebraic derivations, and the N-dipole dark-manifold model and g>0 side condition in Eq. (2) are stated informally.

novelty.basis: The underlying Hopfield A^2, PZW gauge-resolution, dressed-KMS, and ergotropy tools are standard in ultrastrong-coupling cavity QED (Refs. [1, 2, 6, 8]). Novelty lies in synthesizing them into exact rational thermodynamic constraints and gauge-invariant dark-mode bounds specifically tailored to the proposed 71-THz mitochondrial cristae polariton at 310 K, plus the clear separation of bare-basis heating artifacts from collective 1/N-diluted catalysis.

significance.basis: Provides sharp, falsifiable thermodynamic and energetic no-go bounds against naive virtual-photon work extraction or spontaneous ATP synthesis in putative biological USC polaritons, quantifying both the bare-basis Second-Law artifact and the 1/N dilution barrier to passive catalysis. Because the target empirical paper [9] is unrefereed, practical biological impact depends on whether the 71-THz USC claim survives experimental scrutiny.

reproducibility.basis: All physical parameters, exact rational expressions, 16 canonical certificate targets (C01-C16), and 18 Lean theorem statements are specified transparently in the PDF, making every analytical claim independently reproducible by hand. External reproducibility of the archived Lean 4.36.0 proofs, zero-float Python verifier, and 26 unit/forgery tests could not be verified from the PDF alone.

summary: The manuscript derives exact gauge-invariant dressed quantum thermodynamic constraints for a resonant ultrastrong-coupling (USC) vibrational polariton (omega_c = omega_0 = 87 THz, nu_- = 71 THz, eta = 1264/6177 ~ 0.2046) motivated by a 2026 preprint on mitochondrial cristae polaritons [9]. Independent inspection of the PDF confirms the core mathematics: (i) the Hopfield A^2 identity (nu_+ + nu_-)^2 = (omega_c + omega_0)^2 + 4g^2 gives a positive ZPE shift (128/71 h*THz ~ 7.456 meV per resonant mode, crossing 15 k_B T at M = 54 modes); (ii) exact 4x4 resonant symplectic diagonalization yields n_virt = 64/6177 in both Coulomb and Dipole gauges, position squeezing 6177/6305, marginal entanglement det(2V_a) > 1, and <H_int + H_A2>_G = 0; (iii) W_erg(|G>, H_C) = 0 and C_DeltaD(|G>) = 0 forbid virtual-photon work extraction, while naive bare-basis dissipators exceed 310 K dressed KMS excitation by >610x (615x at 71 THz, 477x at 79 THz, 502x at 65 THz); (iv) PZW swaps canonical matter weights (7569/12610 <-> 5041/12610) while leaving the single-branch dipole norm (6177/12610) and (N-1)-dimensional dark manifold invariant; and (v) 1/N dilution limits passive catalysis beneath the 7.456 meV ceiling. Minor quantifier, modeling, and framing gaps merit minor revision.
strengths: Exact analytical 4x4 resonant symplectic diagonalization yields clean rational expressions for virtual occupation (64/6177), quadrature squeezing (6177/6305), marginal purity det(2V_a) = 1 + 4g^2/(nu_+ + nu_-)^2, and <H_int + H_A2>_G = 0.

Clear PZW unitary separation between gauge-dependent canonical matter weights (7569/12610 in Coulomb vs. 5041/12610 in Dipole) and the gauge-invariant single-branch dipole transition matrix element (6177/12610).

Sharp quantitative exposure of bare-basis Lindblad Second-Law artifacts at 310 K, showing non-monotonic competition between growing n_virt and softening thermal factor e^(-beta h nu_-) across 79, 71, and 65 THz.

Balanced thermodynamic critique of USC polaritonic catalysis: exact zero-ergotropy passivity for virtual photons coupled with a realistic 1/N dilution constraint over N = 10^6-10^8 uncorrelated dipoles.

Transparent epistemic scoping in Section 1 and Section 3: the manuscript neither endorses unrefereed empirical claims in [9] nor overclaims that infinite-dimensional Hilbert-space derivations reside inside the Lean 4 kernel.
weaknesses: Several Lean 4 theorems in Table 1 (e.g., Thms. 9, 12, 14, 15, 17) formalize elementary cleared integer/rational tautologies after hand-substitution rather than the physical Hopfield diagonalization, PZW conjugation, or master-equation derivations.

The N-dipole collective Hamiltonian, bright-coordinate definition Q_B, and (N-1)-dimensional dark manifold are invoked in Sections 2.4-2.5 without an explicit multi-dipole derivation, and potential symmetry-breaking dipole-dipole couplings are neglected.

Treating single-mode Delta E_ZPE ~ 7.456 meV as a catalytic ceiling implicitly assumes full decoupling at the transition state (g_TS = 0); more generally the shift is Delta E_ZPE(RS) - Delta E_ZPE(TS), which can vanish or reverse sign.

Multiplying single-mode Delta E_ZPE by M = 54 to benchmark against kappa_bend ~ 15 k_B T assumes M independent resonant modes and omits the ~8*pi geometric prefactor for closed membranes (which raises the threshold by ~25x).
The 'Driven Regime I' row in Table 3 (W_erg = 0 weak-drive, C_DeltaD ~ 0) is not derived in Section 2, and the '+3.61 THz Hopfield A^2 shift' cited in the abstract is undefined in the body text.

The flat-bath KMS comparison (gamma_0 = gamma_downarrow) omits the ~0.40 lower-polariton branch-splitting weight in a|G> when citing the 615x multiplier (though Section 2.3 acknowledges O(1) branch-splitting prefactors).
potential_errors: In the abstract and Eq. (2), 'for every detuning (omega_c, omega_0, g)' omits the strict coupling condition g > 0 required for strict positivity Delta E_ZPE > 0 (correctly included in Lean Thm. 2).

In Section 2.3, k_B T at 310 K is written as 26.713 meV (whereas 310 * 0.0861733 = 26.7137 meV rounds to 26.714 meV); this 0.001 meV truncation does not alter any inequality or reported rounded ratio.

Figure 3b labels its vertical axis n_virt / e^(-beta h nu_-) while plotting the rounded conservative rational lower bounds (611x, 475x, 501x) rather than the exact ratios (615x, 477x, 502x) stated in Section 2.3 and Table 2, although the caption discloses this.

Resonant equality of canonical n_virt in Coulomb and Dipole gauges relies on exact resonance (omega_c = omega_0) and compares gauge-dependent canonical operators (where Dipole p_a represents displacement rather than E_perp); off-resonance canonical occupations differ.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact rational characterization of 310 K USC mito-polariton vacuum observables (n_virt = 64/6177, squeezing 6177/6305, single-branch dipole norm 6177/12610) and non-monotonic bare-vs-dressed KMS error scaling across 79, 71, and 65 THz.
Operational taxonomy (Table 3) separating unphysical bare-basis heating artifacts, passive vacuum/dark Regime I, driven Regime I catalysis under 1/N dilution, and active Regime II coherence.
